query: Any tips on how to tell the cops about illegal mining in Tamil Nadu's woods?
reference_answer:
Reporting Illegal Mining:
To report illegal mining in forest areas of Tamil Nadu, contact the Tamil Nadu Forest Department's toll-free number (1800-425-3355) or visit the nearest forest range office. You can also report anonymously through the department's website or mobile app.
answer: To report illegal mining in Tamil Nadu’s woods to the police, contact the local police station or the Forest Department directly. Provide details like location, dates, and any photos of the illegal activity. [Document 1]
